title: I have created an Interactive AI Audiobook with an RPG DICE (Morpheus: AI Audiobook RPG) I put all my heart in this game...
author: Daemon66x
selftext:
**Hello, my name is Oskar. I didn't use AI to correct my text, so please sorry for my bad English.**

I am on the autism spectrum, and since I was a little kid, I have been programming text adventures (I started with Turbo Pascal on DOS when I was 7). 

When I saw an AI-narrated text adventure app for the first time, I bought a one-month subscription immediately, but it wasn't good at all. The memory was bad, and the quality of the stories was very bad as well. The tiers with higher memory were so expensive that I didn't use it again. 

I was thinking: "Why is there no app that connects an audiobook with the generative AI concept?" This was driving me crazy, so I sat down, and for the last half year, I have been building an app day and night to make my dream possible. I wanted an app that ANYONE can afford. A high-quality audiobook app with ambience sounds and a dice to make your choices more fun... An app that doesn't forget anything, with really high-quality stories, reverb effects for the voices, and a video generator at the end of the story. An app that I can play in bed, saying "1" for the first choice, or simply saying out loud whatever action I want to do, and it recognizes my voice – an app that I can play with my eyes closed in bed, holding my controller.

I have created the game of my dreams. What started as a project for myself is an app you can download right now. You can listen to seamless audiobooks with local AI voices. You can choose from many stories that I wrote, and you can also create your own story. Just choose, hit play, wait a little bit, and enjoy! The game works with BYOK. This means you must bring your own API key from Google.

Why so? There are plenty of apps out there that cost a LOT, and they don't even have a voice narrator. I optimized my app so that with a free API key, you can listen to your audiobooks unlimited. Even when Google has some issues, premium users get SOS chapters to continue playing. I really put all my heart into this app, and I truly did everything I could to make sure the app feels and sounds great. I have so much fun playing it every night before I go to sleep. I made so many great things in my life and no one ever cared once. Even if you people don't like it, I will keep playing it by myself.

I am very proud that I made this. Just launch it and feel all the heart I have put into it!

I would really love to know what you think about the app. Do you think the idea behind it is good? I know that AI sometimes makes mistakes and doesn't always write great stories, but I did everything I could to make the AI build a proper story arc with real tension, along with many other things.

**I hope maybe just one person finds this app because of this post and has fun playing it – even then, this post was worth it!**
